user_input: How many Sick Leave days are allowed per year?

['5. Sick Leave (SL)

Purpose: Sick Leave is granted when an employee is unable to work due to illness, injury, or medical treatment.
Eligibility
• All employees.
Entitlement: • 10 days per calendar year.
Conditions
• Employees should notify their reporting manager as early as possible.
• A medical certificate may be required for Sick Leave exceeding 2 consecutive working days.
• Sick Leave cannot be carried forward.
• Sick Leave cannot be encashed.', '4. Casual Leave (CL)

Purpose: Casual Leave is intended for short-term personal needs, urgent work, or unforeseen circumstances.
Eligibility
• All confirmed employees.
Entitlement: • 12 days per calendar year.
Conditions
• Leave may be taken for half-day or full-day.
• Prior approval from the reporting manager is required whenever possible.
• Casual Leave should normally not exceed 3 consecutive working days.
• Unused Casual Leave cannot be carried forward.
• Casual Leave cannot be encashed.', '6. Earned Leave (EL)

Purpose: Earned Leave provides employees with planned time off for vacation, personal commitments, or rest.
Eligibility
• Confirmed employees after successful completion of probation.
Entitlement: • 18 days per calendar year.
Conditions
• Earned Leave should preferably be planned in advance.
• Leave requests should generally be submitted at least 7 days before the intended leave date.
• Maximum 30 days may be accumulated.
• Any balance beyond the accumulation limit may lapse unless otherwise approved.
• Earned Leave is eligible for encashment as per company policy.', '8. Paternity Leave

Purpose: To allow employees to support their spouse and newborn child.
Eligibility: Male employees who become fathers.
Entitlement: • 5 working days of paid leave.
Conditions
• Should be availed within 90 days of childbirth or adoption.
• Prior approval is required whenever possible.
• Supporting documentation may be requested.', '10. Marriage Leave

Purpose: Marriage Leave allows employees time to celebrate their wedding and complete related personal commitments.
Eligibility: Confirmed employees.
Entitlement: • 5 consecutive working days of paid leave.
Conditions
• Applicable only once during employment with the company.
• Leave should be applied for at least 30 days in advance, wherever possible.
• Employees may be required to provide supporting documents after the marriage.']
